```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_m": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),   # mirror devices M1/M2
    "L_m":    (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_c": (22.0, 12.0, 26.0),   # cascode devices M3/M4
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),
    "vds1":   (0.13, 0.08, 0.2),    # target VDS of mirror devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", iref)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # mirror pair, both at the same VDS = vds1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], iref, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], iout, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source sits at vds1 (body effect included)
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iref, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iout, vds=max(vout - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)

    # series resistor: VA = VB + I*R ; VA - Vgs3 = vds1 ; VB = Vgs1
    vr = vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs
    R = max(vr, 0.02) / iref

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference side: node iin (A) -R- nb (B); M3 drain=B gate=A; M1 gate=B
    n.R("R1", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("M3", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # mirrored side
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m2)

    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / m4.gds / m2.gds + 1.0 / m2.gds
    vcomp = vds1 + max(m4.vdsat, 4 * UT) + 0.01
    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": 0.5,
        "v_compliance": vcomp,
        "rout": rout,
        "power": 1.8 * (iref + iout),
    }
```
